content.value_statement: Complex animation can break when frames are rendered out of sequence. This skill guides deterministic keyframes and focused visual diagnostics for reliable HyperFrames output.
actual_capabilities: Selects focused mechanisms for paths, masks, SVG drawing, shape morphing, shared elements, text motion, and 3D depth.
Defines deterministic runtime rules for GSAP, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, canvas, and WebGL.
Structures explicit poses, timing, easing, final holds, and runtime registration for seek-safe rendering.
Identifies unstable patterns such as timers, autoplay, unseeded randomness, asynchronous timelines, and infinite loops.
Guides verification with HyperFrames lint, validation, keyframe diagnostics, focused shots, ghost views, and snapshots.
limitations: It focuses on keyframe implementation and verification, not broad story planning or visual direction.
It does not source media, write captions, define branding, or redesign an existing composition.
Example distances, timings, selectors, and proof angles must be adapted to each project.
CLI verification requires a trusted local HyperFrames installation and any selected animation libraries or plugins.

use_cases.title: Implement Product Motion
use_cases.description: Create deterministic UI state changes, shared-element transitions, and readable final states for a product demonstration.

use_cases.title: Verify Video Keyframes
use_cases.description: Check proof poses, route timing, final holds, and selector ownership before rendering a HyperFrames composition.

use_cases.title: Debug 3D Animation
use_cases.description: Diagnose missing depth, camera movement, occlusion, shader progress, and canvas motion with focused visual evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Create Basic Motion
prompt_templates.prompt: Create seek-safe keyframes for [subject] moving from [start] to [end] in [duration]. Keep the final pose visible.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Mechanism
prompt_templates.prompt: Choose the smallest HyperFrames mechanism for [effect]. Explain the visible poses, runtime choice, and proof times before proposing implementation.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Seek Safety
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this animation plan for seek safety: [details]. Identify unstable timing, registration issues, overlapping channels, and missing final-state verification.

prompt_templates.title: Design Complex Proof
prompt_templates.prompt: Design deterministic keyframes for [complex scene] using [runtime]. Include 3D depth or SVG motion, diagnostic commands, proof angles, and snapshot times.

output_examples.input: Animate one card from a compact list into a full detail panel.
output: Preserve one card element through the transition.
Measure source and target boxes before movement.
Use a continuous transform with a clear middle proof pose.
Hold the expanded final state for snapshot verification.

output_examples.input: A logo follows a curved route but the movement looks uneven.
output_examples.output: Use path progress with tangent rotation and constant parent easing. Compare strip-shot spacing at bends, then verify the final position.

output_examples.input: A WebGL scene looks flat in the diagnostic image.
output_examples.output: Add camera or object depth travel, visible occlusion, and one angled proof view. Verify internal motion with ghost images and timed snapshots.

best_practices: Define the subject, visible poses, final state, and duration before selecting an animation mechanism.
Use deterministic timing, finite loops, synchronous construction, and registered runtime instances.
Verify the smallest failing behavior with focused shots and snapshots before running a full render.
anti_patterns: Do not use timers, autoplay, unseeded randomness, or unregistered animation frames for render-critical motion.
Do not replace one continuous subject with unrelated elements when identity must remain visible.
Do not copy example distances or timings without adapting them to composition geometry and duration.

faq.question: Which animation runtimes does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers GSAP, CSS keyframes, Anime.js, WAAPI, canvas, WebGL, and Three.js-oriented keyframe patterns.

faq.question: Does it create a complete video concept?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on keyframe mechanics, runtime determinism, visible poses, and verification.

faq.question: How does it support seek-safe rendering?
faq.answer: It favors paused or registered runtimes, synchronous construction, finite timing, explicit states, and deterministic progress.

faq.question: Can it help with SVG animation?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers stroke drawing, path travel, shape interpolation, masks, and snapshot-based verification.

faq.question: How are 3D scenes verified?
faq.answer: Use camera or object keyframes, occlusion, diagnostic angles, ghost views, and snapshots at proof poses.

faq.question: What must I provide in a prompt?
faq.answer: Provide the animated subject, start and final states, duration, runtime, important intermediate poses, and available project files.
